text: A psalm of David. Lord, who may dwell in your sanctuary? Who may live on your holy hill?
and who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from his heart
who does his neighbor no wrong and casts no slur on his fellowman,
but honors those who fear the Lord, who keeps his oath even when it hurts,
and does not accept a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.
